plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter Birthday = '1959-02-18' and dates in Nov/Dec 1981; compute decrease rate from November T-CHO to December T-CHO.

direct.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND Laboratory.GPT > 30
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 4;

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.ID FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE e."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' AND l.GPT > 30 AND l.ALB < 4 ORDER BY e.ID;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Examination and Laboratory on ID, filter Examination Date between 1987-07-06 and 1996-01-31, GPT > 30, ALB < 4; count distinct patient IDs and list them.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 2 AND T1."ANA Pattern" = 'S' AND T1."aCL IgM" > (SELECT AVG("aCL IgM") * 1.2 FROM Examination);

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2 AND e.[ANA Pattern] = 'S' AND e.[aCL IgM] > 1.2 * (SELECT AVG([aCL IgM]) FROM Examination);
plan.plan: Plan: Join Examination and Patient on ID; filter Thrombosis=2, ANA Pattern='S', and aCL IgM > 1.2 × overall average aCL IgM; count distinct patients.

direct.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.Date >= '1991-10-01' AND l.Date < '1991-11-01'
  AND l.T-BIL BETWEEN 0.2 AND 1.2;

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.ID FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Admission = '-' AND l.Date >= '1991-10-01' AND l.Date < '1991-11-01' AND l.T-BIL BETWEEN 0.2 AND 1.2;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient to Laboratory on ID; filter Admission = '-' (outpatient) and Date in October 1991; filter T-BIL within normal range (0.2–1.2 mg/dL).

direct.sql: SELECT AVG(L.ALB) FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.PLT > 400 AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

plan.sql: SELECT AVG(L.ALB) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.PLT > 400 AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient, Laboratory, and Examination on ID; filter SEX='F', PLT>400, and Diagnosis='SLE'; compute AVG(ALB).

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Examination.Diagnosis = 'APS';

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND e.Diagnosis = 'APS';
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient to Examination on ID; filter Patient.SEX = 'F' and Examination.Diagnosis = 'APS'; count distinct patients.

direct.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1980' AND T1.Diagnosis = 'RA'

plan.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1980' AND e.Diagnosis = 'RA';
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Examination on ID; filter Birthday year 1980 and Diagnosis 'RA'; compute percentage of SEX='F' among those patients.

direct.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN UA BETWEEN 2.4 AND 7.0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS within_normal_range FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 57266;

plan.sql: SELECT UA FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 57266;
plan.plan: Plan: Select UA from Laboratory where ID = 57266. No aggregation needed; return the UA value(s) to assess normality.

direct.sql: SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.GPT > 40;

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.ID FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.GPT > 40;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter SEX='M' and GPT above normal range (>40); select distinct patient IDs.

direct.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.GPT > 40 ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC;

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.GPT > 40 ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter Laboratory.GPT above normal range (>40); select Patient.Diagnosis ordered by Patient.Birthday ascending.

direct.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UN = 20;

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.UN = 20;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter Laboratory.UN equal to the normal upper limit (assume 20 as borderline passing); select Patient.ID, SEX, Birthday.

direct.sql:
SELECT P.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.T_BIL NOT BETWEEN 0.2 AND 1.2
GROUP BY P.SEX;

plan.sql: SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.T-BIL IS NOT NULL AND (l.T-BIL < 0.2 OR l.T-BIL > 1.2) GROUP BY p.SEX;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter Laboratory rows where T-BIL is outside the normal range (assume normal 0.2–1.2 mg/dL); group by Patient.SEX and count patients.

direct.sql: SELECT AVG((julianday(p.First Date) - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.T-CHO > 220;

plan.sql: SELECT AVG((julianday(L.Date) - julianday(P.Birthday)) / 365.25) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L."T-CHO" > 240;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter SEX='M' and T-CHO above the high-cholesterol threshold (240); compute average age from Birthday to Date.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.TG > 150 AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) > 50;

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.TG > 150 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))) > 50;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter TG > 150 (above normal); compute age from Birthday to Date and count patients older than 50.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND p.Birthday BETWEEN '1936-01-01' AND '1956-12-31' AND l.CPK > 200;

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND p.Birthday BETWEEN '1936-01-01' AND '1956-12-31' AND l.CPK > 200;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter SEX='M' and Birthday between 1936 and 1956; count distinct patients with CPK above normal range (assume >200).

direct.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (l.GLU < 70 OR l.GLU > 110)
  AND l.T-CHO BETWEEN 150 AND 220;

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.Birthday))/365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE (l.GLU < 70 OR l.GLU > 110) AND l.T-CHO BETWEEN 150 AND 220;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter GLU outside 70–110 and T-CHO within 150–220; compute age from Birthday and select ID, SEX, age.

direct.sql:
SELECT p.ID, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS age, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RBC < (SELECT AVG(RBC) FROM Laboratory);

plan.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.Diagnosis, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS Age FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.RBC = (SELECT MIN(RBC) FROM Laboratory);
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter to the minimum RBC value (lowest red blood cell count); select patient ID, diagnosis, and age computed from Birthday.

direct.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.HGB >= 12.0
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

plan.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.HGB >= 12 ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' and normal HGB (e.g., HGB >= 12); order by oldest (earliest Birthday) and return ID, SEX.

direct.sql:
SELECT p.ID, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.HCT > 50
GROUP BY p.ID
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

plan.sql: SELECT p.ID, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.Birthday))/365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.HCT > 50 GROUP BY p.ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.Date) >= 2;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter HCT above normal (>~50 for males, >~45 for females, or simply HCT > 50 as abnormal); group by patient ID and count distinct lab dates having elevated HCT, keeping those with count >= 2; compute age from Birthday.

direct.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 150 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_plt, SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_plt FROM Laboratory WHERE PLT IS NOT NULL;

plan.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 150 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_platelet_patients, SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_platelet_patients FROM Laboratory WHERE PLT IS NOT NULL AND (PLT < 150 OR PLT > 400);
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; abnormal platelet = PLT outside normal range (assume normal 150–400). Count patients with PLT < 150 vs PLT > 400.

direct.sql:
SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1984'
  AND (strftime('%Y', l.Date) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) < 50
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 150 AND 450;

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, l.Date, l.PLT FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.Date >= '1984-01-01' AND l.Date < '1985-01-01' AND l.PLT BETWEEN 150000 AND 450000 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))) < 50;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Laboratory and Patient on ID; filter Laboratory.Date in 1984 and PLT within normal range (150000–450000); compute age from Birthday and keep patients under 50.

direct.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.PT > 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE (julianday('now') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 > 55;

plan.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 55 AND l.PT IS NOT NULL AND (l.PT < 11 OR l.PT > 14);
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter patients older than 55 (using Birthday vs First Date or current date) and PT outside normal range; compute percentage female among those with abnormal PT.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.WBC BETWEEN 4.0 AND 10.0 AND (l.FG < 200 OR l.FG > 400);

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.WBC BETWEEN 4.0 AND 10.0 AND (l.FG < 200 OR l.FG > 400);
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient, Laboratory, and Examination on ID; filter SEX='M', normal WBC (4.0–10.0), and abnormal fibrinogen (FG outside 200–400); count distinct patients.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.IGG > 1600;

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.IGG > 1600;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient to Laboratory on ID; filter Laboratory.IGG above the normal upper limit (assume >1600 mg/dL); count distinct patients.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.IGG BETWEEN 900 AND 2000 AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL AND e.Symptoms != '';

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.IGG BETWEEN 700 AND 1600 AND p.Admission IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.Admission) <> '';
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient to Laboratory on ID, filter Laboratory.IGG within normal range (700–1600), and count distinct patients whose Patient.Admission indicates symptoms (non-empty/positive).

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGA < 400 AND T1.`First Date` > '1990-01-01'

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.IGA BETWEEN 70 AND 400 AND p."First Date" > '1990-01-01';
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient to Laboratory on ID; filter Laboratory.IGA within normal range (assume 70–400) and Patient.First Date > '1990-01-01'; count distinct patients.

direct.sql: SELECT Diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE IGM > 200 GROUP BY Diagnosis ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

plan.sql: SELECT p.Diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.IGM > 200 OR l.IGM < 50 GROUP BY p.Diagnosis ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Examination and Patient on ID; filter Laboratory IGM outside normal range (assume >200 or <50 as abnormal) — but IGM is in Laboratory, so join Laboratory too. Group by Patient.Diagnosis and count, order descending limit 1.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRP IS NOT NULL AND Laboratory.CRP != '' AND Laboratory.CRP != '0' AND Laboratory.CRP != '-' AND (Laboratory.CRP NOT GLOB '*[0-9]*' OR CAST(Laboratory.CRP AS REAL) > 0.5);

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory l LEFT JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID WHERE l.CRP IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.CRP) NOT IN ('', '-', 'negative', 'Negative', 'NEG', 'neg') AND e.ID IS NULL;
plan.plan: Plan: Count distinct Patient IDs from Laboratory where CRP indicates abnormal (non-empty, not negative/normal) and no matching Examination record exists for that patient.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CRE > 1.2 AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) < 70;

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CRE > 1.2 AND (julianday('now') - julianday(p.Birthday))/365.25 < 70;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter abnormal creatinine (CRE > 1.2) and age < 70 using Birthday; count distinct patients.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RNP = 'normal' AND Patient.Admission = '+';

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Admission = '+' AND l.RNP = '(-)';
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter Patient.Admission = '+' and Laboratory.RNP indicating normal (e.g., negative); count distinct patients.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE l.SM = 'normal' AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE (l.SM IS NULL OR l.SM NOT LIKE '%+%') AND (e.Thrombosis IS NULL OR e.Thrombosis = 0);
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient to Laboratory on ID to filter normal anti-SM (SM is NULL or not positive), then count distinct patients whose Examination Thrombosis is not 1.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE l.SC170 = 'negative' AND p.SEX = 'F' AND (e.Symptoms IS NULL OR e.Symptoms = '');

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND (l.SC170 IS NULL OR TRIM(l.SC170) = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(l.SC170)) = 'negative') AND (e.Symptoms IS NULL OR TRIM(e.Symptoms) = '');
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter SC170 normal (empty/negative) and SEX='F'; count distinct patients with no Symptoms in Examination (or no Examination symptoms).

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CENTROMEA = 'normal' AND Laboratory.SSB = 'normal' AND Patient.SEX = 'M';

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND (l.CENTROMEA IS NULL OR l.CENTROMEA = '' OR l.CENTROMEA = '-') AND (l.SSB IS NULL OR l.SSB = '' OR l.SSB = '-');
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient and Laboratory on ID; filter CENTROMEA and SSB to normal (negative/empty) values; count distinct male patients.

direct.sql: SELECT p.Birthday FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.GOT > 40 ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1;

plan.sql: SELECT MAX(p.Birthday) FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.GOT > 40;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Examination and Laboratory on ID to find patients with abnormal GOT (above normal range, e.g., >40), then join Patient to get Birthday, and select the maximum Birthday (youngest patient).

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.CPK BETWEEN 45 AND 163 AND T2.KCT = '+'

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE l.CPK BETWEEN 0 AND 200 AND (e.KCT = 'positive' OR e.RVVT = 'positive' OR e.LAC = 'positive');
plan.plan: Plan: Join Patient to Laboratory on ID; filter CPK within normal range (assume 0–200) and positive coagulation measure (KCT/RVVT/LAC positive in Examination); count distinct patients.

direct.sql: SELECT l.name FROM League l JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE m.season = '2016' GROUP BY l.id ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1;

plan.sql: SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id WHERE Match.season = '2016' GROUP BY League.id, League.name ORDER BY SUM(Match.home_team_goal + Match.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1;
plan.plan: Plan: Join League to Match on league_id, filter season='2016', sum home_team_goal + away_team_goal per league, order descending and limit 1.

direct.sql:
SELECT t.team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2010'
  AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

plan.sql: SELECT m.away_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Scotland' AND l.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m.season = '2010' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Match to League and Country to filter Scotland Premier League and season 2010; filter away wins (away_team_goal > home_team_goal); group by away_team_api_id and count, order desc limit 1.

direct.sql:
SELECT t.team_long_name, ta.buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
ORDER BY ta.buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name, ta.buildUpPlaySpeed, ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.buildUpPlaySpeed DESC LIMIT 4;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Team_Attributes to Team on team_api_id, order by buildUpPlaySpeed descending, take top 4 distinct teams, and return their buildUpPlaySpeedClass (speed of attack buildup).

direct.sql: SELECT l.name FROM League l JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE m.season = '2016' AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal GROUP BY l.id, l.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

plan.sql: SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id WHERE Match.season = '2016' AND Match.home_team_goal = Match.away_team_goal GROUP BY League.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
plan.plan: Plan: Join League to Match on league_id, filter season='2016' and home_team_goal=away_team_goal, group by league name, order by count descending, limit 1.

direct.sql:
SELECT AVG((julianday('now') - julianday(Player.birthday)) / 365.25) AS average_age
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND Player_Attributes.date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31';

plan.sql: SELECT AVG((strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', p.birthday)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', p.birthday))) AS avg_age FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97 AND pa.date >= '2013-01-01' AND pa.date <= '2015-12-31';
plan.plan: Plan: Join Player and Player_Attributes on player_api_id; filter attributes date between 2013 and 2015 and sprint_speed >= 97; compute current age from birthday and aggregate (average age).

direct.sql: SELECT l.name, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id GROUP BY l.id, l.name ORDER BY match_count DESC LIMIT 1;

plan.sql: SELECT League.name, COUNT(Match.id) AS match_count FROM League JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id GROUP BY League.id, League.name ORDER BY match_count DESC LIMIT 1;
plan.plan: Plan: Join League to Match on league_id, group by league name, count matches, order descending, limit 1.

direct.sql: SELECT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.team_fifa_api_id FROM Team t JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND ta.buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;
plan.plan: Plan: Join Team_Attributes to Team on team_api_id, filter buildUpPlaySpeed between 51 and 59, select distinct team_fifa_api_id.

direct.sql: SELECT t.team_long_name FROM Team t JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012' AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012')

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name FROM Team t JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date LIKE '2012%' AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE date LIKE '2012%');

direct.sql: SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1998-12-27' THEN t.balance END) - MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END)) * 100.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT l.account_id FROM loan l WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY l.loan_id LIMIT 1);

plan.sql: SELECT (b2.balance - b1.balance) * 100.0 / b1.balance FROM (SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY loan_id LIMIT 1) AND date <= '1993-03-22' ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) b1, (SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY loan_id LIMIT 1) AND date <= '1998-12-27' ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) b2;
plan.plan: Plan: Find the loan with date '1993-07-05' (earliest if multiple), get its account_id, then get that account's balance on 1993-03-22 and 1998-12-27 from trans (latest balance on/before each date), and compute the increase rate.

direct.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amount) FROM loan;

plan.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan;
plan.plan: Plan: Aggregate loan table by status; compute sum of amounts for status 'A' (fully paid, no issue) divided by total sum of amounts, times 100.

direct.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000;

plan.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_running_no_issue FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000;
plan.plan: Plan: Join loan to account; filter loan.amount < 100000; compute percentage of loans with status 'C' (running/no issue) among those.

direct.sql:
SELECT d.A2, d.A3, (d.A13 - d.A12) AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'C'
GROUP BY d.district_id;

plan.sql: SELECT d.A2, d.A3, (d.A13 - d.A12) AS unemployment_increment FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status = 'C' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A12, d.A13;
plan.plan: Plan: Join loan (status 'C' or running) to account, disp, client, district. Filter loans in debt (status 'C' with payments). Aggregate district A2/A3 and compute unemployment increment A13 (1996) minus A12 (1995) as percentage.

direct.sql:
SELECT d.A2, COUNT(*) AS female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

plan.sql: SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_account_holders FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' GROUP BY a.district_id ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC LIMIT 9;
plan.plan: Plan: Join client to disp to account, filter client.gender = 'F', group by account.district_id, count distinct clients, order by count descending, limit 9.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND l.amount >= 250000 AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id WHERE loan.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND loan.amount >= 250000 AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';
plan.plan: Plan: Join loan to account on account_id; filter loan.date between 1995-01-01 and 1997-12-31, loan.amount >= 250000, and account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'; count qualifying loans.

direct.sql:
SELECT d.A2, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date >= '1996-01-01' AND t.date < '1996-02-01'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC
LIMIT 10;

plan.sql: SELECT d.A2, d.A3, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1996-01-01' AND t.date < '1996-02-01' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3 ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC LIMIT 10;
plan.plan: Plan: Join trans to account to district; filter operation withdrawals (VKLAD excluded / type debit) in Jan 1996; group by district A2/A3 and sum amounts, order desc limit 10.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM account WHERE district_id = 1 AND frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'branch location 1';
plan.plan: Plan: Join account to district on district_id, filter district A3 = 'branch location 1' (or district_id = 1), count distinct accounts.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY A16 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1);

plan.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE gender = 'M' AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY A16 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1);
plan.plan: Plan: Join district to client; find district with second-highest A16 (crimes 1995) using ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1; count male clients in that district.

direct.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id FROM disp d JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.issued) = '1998' AND t.amount < (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans)

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id WHERE strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998' AND t.amount < (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1998');
plan.plan: Plan: Join client→disp→account→trans (and card via disp) to find card transactions in 1998; filter trans.amount below the 1998 average; return distinct client_ids.

direct.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.frequency FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan) AND d.A11 > 8000 AND d.A11 <= 9000

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.frequency FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A11 > 8000 AND d.A11 <= 9000 AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);
plan.plan: Plan: Join account to district on district_id; filter district average salary (A11) > 8000 and <= 9000; select distinct account.frequency (account type) excluding accounts that have loans.

direct.sql: SELECT AVG(d.A15) FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE d.A15 > 4000 AND strftime('%Y', a.date) >= '1997' GROUP BY d.district_id;

plan.sql: SELECT AVG(d.A15) FROM district d WHERE d.A15 > 4000 AND d.district_id IN (SELECT a.district_id FROM account a WHERE a.date >= '1997-01-01');
plan.plan: Plan: Join district to account (district_id), filter account.date >= '1997-01-01', group by district, filter districts with A15 (crimes 1995) > 4000, then average A15.

direct.sql: SELECT t.* FROM trans t JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.client_id = 3356 AND t.operation = 'VYBER';

plan.sql: SELECT t.* FROM trans t JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.client_id = 3356 AND t.operation IN ('VYBER', 'VYBER KARTOU');
plan.plan: Plan: Join client→disp→account→trans; filter client_id=3356 and operation indicating cash withdrawal (VYBER/VYBER KARTOU); select transaction details.

direct.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

plan.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE di.A11 > 10000;
plan.plan: Plan: Join client→disp→account→district; filter district.A11 > 10000; compute percentage of clients with gender 'F' among distinct clients.

direct.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

plan.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');
plan.plan: Plan: Join loan→account→disp→client to filter male clients and loan dates in 1996–1997. Aggregate loan amount by year. Compute growth rate as (1997 total − 1996 total) / 1996 total.

direct.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3 AND k_symbol = 'SLUZBY' AND operation = 'VYBER' AND amount = 3539;

plan.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3 AND operation = 'VYBER KARTOU') AS statement_count, (SELECT k_symbol FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3 AND amount = -3539 LIMIT 1) AS debit_aim;
plan.plan: Plan: Query trans for account_id 3 with operation indicating statement issuance, count them; then find the k_symbol/operation for transactions on account 3 summing to 3539 debited.

direct.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'M';

plan.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'M';
plan.plan: Plan: Join client to disp to account; filter gender='M' and frequency='POPLATEK TYDNE'; compute percentage of male clients with weekly statements.

direct.sql: SELECT T1.account_id FROM account AS T1 JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id JOIN district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id WHERE T3.gender = 'F' ORDER BY T3.birth_date ASC, T4.A11 ASC LIMIT 1

plan.sql: SELECT a.account_id FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, di.A11 ASC LIMIT 1;
plan.plan: Plan: Join client, disp, account, and district; filter gender='F'; find the oldest female client by birth_date and lowest average salary via district A11; select account_id.

direct.sql: SELECT AVG(amount) FROM loan WHERE status = 'C' AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM trans WHERE date > loan.date);

plan.sql: SELECT AVG(loan.amount) FROM loan JOIN trans ON loan.account_id = trans.account_id WHERE loan.status = 'C' AND trans.date > loan.date;
plan.plan: Plan: Join loan to account and trans on account_id; filter loan.status = 'C' (running contract) and trans.date > loan.date (transactions after loan issuance); compute average loan amount.

direct.sql:
SELECT c.client_id, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
GROUP BY c.client_id;

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id WHERE ca.type = 'gold' AND l.status = 'A';
plan.plan: Plan: Join client to disp, card, and loan via account_id; filter card.type = 'gold' and loan.status = 'A' (eligible/running); compute age from birth_date and select client_id and age.

direct.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND a.date > t.date;

plan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3 FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date LIKE '1993%' AND a.date > t.date;
plan.plan: Plan: Join account to district on district_id; filter account.date in 1993 and account.date > trans.date (statement issued after transaction); select account_id, A2, A3.

direct.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND di.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) BETWEEN '1995' AND '2000';

plan.sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';
plan.plan: Plan: Join account to district on district_id, filter district A3 = 'east Bohemia' and account date between 1995 and 2000, select account_id and frequency.
